mapper.select: SELECT so.sales_order_id AS "salesOrderId", so.order_no AS "orderNo", so.customer_id AS "customerId", bp.partner_name AS "customerName", so.order_status AS "orderStatus", so.shipment_status AS "shipmentStatus" FROM sales_order so JOIN business_partner bp ON bp.partner_id = so.customer_id WHERE so.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY so.sales_order_id DESC

SELECT so.sales_order_id AS "salesOrderId", so.order_no AS "orderNo", so.customer_id AS "customerId", bp.partner_name AS "customerName", so.order_status AS "orderStatus", so.shipment_status AS "shipmentStatus" FROM sales_order so JOIN business_partner bp ON bp.partner_id = so.customer_id WHERE so.company_id = #{companyId} AND so.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId}

SELECT soi.sales_order_item_id AS "salesOrderItemId", soi.product_unit_id AS "productUnitId", p.product_id AS "productId", p.product_name AS "productName", p.lot_managed_yn AS "lotManagedYn", soi.conversion_qty AS "conversionQty", soi.ordered_qty AS "orderedQty", soi.unit_price AS "unitPrice", soi.shipped_qty / soi.conversion_qty AS "shippedQty", (soi.base_ordered_qty - soi.shipped_qty) / soi.conversion_qty AS "remainingQty" FROM sales_order_item soi JOIN sales_order so ON so.sales_order_id = soi.sales_order_id JOIN product p ON p.product_id = soi.product_id WHERE so.company_id = #{companyId} AND soi.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} ORDER BY soi.line_no

SELECT p.company_id AS "companyId", p.product_id AS "productId", pu.conversion_qty AS "conversionQty", p.tax_type AS "taxType" FROM product_unit pu JOIN product p ON p.product_id = pu.product_id WHERE pu.product_unit_id = #{productUnitId} AND pu.use_yn = 'Y' AND p.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales_order ( company_id, order_no, customer_id, order_status, shipment_status, total_supply_amount, total_tax_amount, total_amount, created_by ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{orderNo}, #{customerId}, 'DRAFT', 'NOT_SHIPPED', #{totalSupplyAmount}, #{totalTaxAmount}, #{totalAmount}, #{createdBy} )

INSERT INTO sales_order_item ( sales_order_id, line_no, product_id, product_unit_id, ordered_qty, conversion_qty, base_ordered_qty, shipped_qty, unit_price, tax_type, supply_amount, tax_amount, total_amount, version, created_by ) VALUES ( #{salesOrderId}, #{lineNo}, #{item.productId}, #{item.productUnitId}, #{item.orderedQty}, #{item.conversionQty}, #{item.baseOrderedQty}, 0, #{item.unitPrice}, #{item.taxType}, #{item.supplyAmount}, #{item.taxAmount}, #{item.totalAmount}, 0, #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sales_order SET order_status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_at = CAST( SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP ), confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, updated_at = CAST( SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP ), updated_by = #{confirmedBy} WHERE sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} AND company_id = #{companyId} AND order_status = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE sales_order SET customer_id = #{salesOrder.customerId}, total_supply_amount = #{salesOrder.totalSupplyAmount}, total_tax_amount = #{salesOrder.totalTaxAmount}, total_amount = #{salesOrder.totalAmount}, updated_at = CAST( SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP ), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE sales_order_id = #{salesOrder.salesOrderId} AND company_id = #{salesOrder.companyId} AND order_status = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE sales_order so SET order_status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = CAST( SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP ), updated_by = #{cancelledBy} WHERE so.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} AND so.company_id = #{companyId} AND so.order_status IN ('DRAFT', 'CONFIRMED') AND so.shipment_status = 'NOT_SHIPPED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM outbound ob WHERE ob.sales_order_id = so.sales_order_id AND ob.company_id = so.company_id AND ob.status IN ('DRAFT', 'CONFIRMED') )
